title: Every check runs, in position order, even after one fails
when: Runs three check rows, the second of which reads a table that does not exist.
then: Expects their problems in position order, with the failing check reported as one error saying it could not run.

title: The rail lists the products in order with their icons or monograms
then: Checks the icon and color fields and the monogram, then expects three products in ID order with a monogram, a monogram for an icon too long, an emoji icon, and nothing after them.

title: Alt and a number switch spaces, and the palette has Switch to commands
when: From the products page, presses Alt+3 and Alt+1.
then: Expects a number with no space left alone and Ctrl+Shift+M still opening the space's Checks, and runs a Switch to command from the palette.

title: The current space is the page's product and is marked
then: Expects the product of product, domain, record, group and Checks pages and none for the products and the format, the mark and accent bar on the current space, and the space kept on its Checks page.

title: The current page's branch opens itself
then: Expects a requirement's page to open its use case's folder, a component's page Technical specification with the component marked, a group page its kind's folder and its eyebrow to name Design › Interaction design, and a domain page its domain.

title: Folder names and order come from the schema sections, in the nav and on the domain page alike
then: Expects a renamed and reordered folder to show with its new name and place in both the nav and the domain page's headings.

title: A capability's flows and tests sit in their folders, its use cases under it
then: Expects each folder's records, with a capability's flow and test lifted into Interaction design and Test plan; the domain page's Use cases headed Capabilities, then Use cases outside any capability; and a capability's use case opening its capability's branch.

title: A kind in no known folder gets a folder of its own
then: Expects a Define kind with no folder at the end of Define, a kind of no stage after the stages, and each kind's folder path.

title: What is folded is remembered for the session, and every record is listed without sections
then: Expects open rows to stay open on another page, kept in session storage only, and, without sections, one folder per kind under its stage.

title: Technical specification lists layers in order, each with its components, then those outside any layer
then: Expects three layers whose order is not their ID order in their order, each with its components, then "Components outside any layer", the folder counting components; and a domain with no layers listing its components directly.

title: Test plan puts each test in one group by family, then by what it proves, empty groups left out
then: Expects tests in the seven groups (acceptance, domain rule, pattern, interaction, UI, design and engineering): a capability's test in Acceptance within its capability, acceptance tests by capability in order and by the first use case each proves, a test proving two kinds in the first group, a view's interaction requirement and `test_type` `ui` in UI tests, `test_type` `design` and a test with only `supports` links in Design checks, no empty groups, and no group level when only one group has tests.

title: In the graph a domain's Test plan folder holds the test plan's groups, from the same folder model
then: Expects the Tests folder's group nodes with their counts and the folder model's keys, a test reached through its folder, acceptance, capability and use case one column each left to right, tests hanging straight under the folder when one group has them all, and a test group's own page.

title: A record with several kinds of child has a labeled, counted group per kind
then: Checks which records are grouped (only those with more than one kind of child, however many of one kind), the groups' labels such as "Requirements (6)", their members, and that a group's ID is its parent and kind and names no record.

title: A group can be the focus: its parent and all its members are shown, and depth counts levels from it
when: Centers on the Capabilities folder.
then: Expects its stage and every member, the spine through it, the members' children and groups framed at depth 2 and their members at depth 3, nothing for a group that does not exist, an older kind group's address still working, and its `/<domain-id>/<stage>/<folder>` address both ways, the old `/graph/...` one leading there.

title: The graph's tree is the nav's tree
then: Expects a domain's stages and folders in the nav's order and counts, Capabilities as one list, a capability's use cases as its children with its test in the Test plan, Interaction design split by kind, Technical specification's layers then components, the product's Shared folder before its domains, and every child's parent to be the node that lists it.

title: The layout gives the same map every time, whatever the focus, with no overlaps
when: Builds the map of the test workspace twice.
then: Expects the same map for the same index and the same places and sizes for an index built again, no two boxes overlapping, the nav's order within a level, and a trace's picture centered on its focus.

title: The page draws the map in columns with a solid parent/child spine, and links between siblings never move anything
when: Opens a requirement's graph with Links on.
then: Expects the use case left of the requirement, the component and the test that link to it at their own places in the map, and a solid spine; then two sibling aggregates that link to each other, in one column, with both links drawn between them.

title: Every group is in the map with all its members beside it, and the spine runs record, group, record
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2.
then: Expects its stages and folders as groups with their counts, the spine running through a group to its records, every group in the map holding all its members right beside it and spanning them exactly, and cross-links running record to record.

title: Trace mode has no groups, and filters hide groups with their kind or the parent relation
then: Expects no groups in a trace, no group for a hidden kind, no groups at all when parent/child is hidden, and the same graph every time.

title: Siblings of mixed kinds share a column
then: Expects a component's sibling groups in one column and their members of several kinds in the next, every node with the same parent in one column, and a domain's open groups' members of eight kinds at one x position on the canvas.

title: Ancestors sit to the left of the focus and descendants to its right
then: Expects a use case's product, domain and group in columns 0 to 2, the use case in column 3 and its requirement in column 4, and the same order on the canvas.

title: A cross-linked record sits one column after its source
when: With parent lines hidden.
then: Expects a view one column after the requirement it fulfills and an endpoint one after the view; expects a test one column after the requirement it proves, unless the domain is shown, when it sits beside the use case as the domain's child.

title: A group sits in its own column between its parent and its members
then: Expects a domain, its use case group, the use cases, a use case's requirement group and its opened members each one column further right, the group beside another use case's ungrouped requirement.

title: Within a column nodes follow their parent's place, then the nav's order, and keep it when the graph re-centers
then: Expects use cases by ID, their children in their parents' order, a domain's groups in kind order, rows numbered from 0 and drawn top to bottom, and the same order after re-centring.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera on the shared motion, and no box moves or changes size
when: Opens a use case's graph, framed at once, clicks its requirement.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: A parent spans its children stacked, an equal part each, from its top edge to its bottom edge, each child beside it, nothing overlapping
when: Builds the maps of three workspaces, two synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every root the product box's height, every parent's children of one height, stacked from its top to its bottom a tenth of each one's part apart, each in the next level right of it, no two boxes in a level overlapping, the busy part and the quiet one the same height with the busy one's children smaller, and the tree the nav's.

title: A parent line runs level from the parent's right edge to the child's left edge, at the child's middle
then: Expects every parent line of the map level at its child's middle, from the parent's right edge to the child's left edge, and a cross-link leaving each box on the side facing the other.

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each step stable, the camera different at each, and every box seen to keep the same place and size in the map throughout.

title: Each product has its own graph map
then: Expects Demo shop's map to have Demo shop as its single root and only its nodes, a record of no product to root a map of its own, and the graph with Links on to draw nothing of Notebook.

title: The graph reads left to right by column, and so does a trace
then: Expects one x and one width per level of the map, levels left to right a gap apart, ancestors to the left of a record, and a trace's columns from the requirement to its files.

title: Every box in a column has its width, a fixed fraction of the map
then: In the Tree maps of three workspaces and three synthetic trees every column 0.4 times as wide as the one before from the product's, with a gap before it of 0.15 times its width, every box in a column at its place and width, and the map as wide as its columns.

title: Tall parents carry their height and text scale, every box its text scale as its box scale, and every parent line is level
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain taller than its stages stacked with a text scale above 1, every drawn box's box scale its text scale, and every parent line drawn level.

title: A label keeps its size in the map: its text scale is the map's, and the camera never changes it
then: Checks every box's text scale is at most its column's width over 400, set by the map, and that at a quarter, one and four times a domain's framing zoom every drawn box carries no text size of its own: the camera never changes a label.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, the domain, its stages and their folders are framed in the canvas, each showing its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain, every stage and at least half the folders wholly in the canvas, and every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: In the Tree map siblings share one text scale, their column's width's share or the largest at which every sibling's label fits, and every label fits its box
when: In the Tree maps of three workspaces and three synthetic trees.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one box size and one text scale, above 0, equal to the least of their labels' largest fits within their column's width over 400 (a title with a word too wide for its column lowering its siblings' scale with its own); every label's lines to give back its title and its kind and ID line, each line's estimated width within its box's width over its scale, less the padding, its shape's room and (beside the kind and ID line) its marks and badge, no word broken, its lines and border no taller than its box, and every label centered; and that the estimate errs wide and wrapping breaks only after a space, a word too wide for a line after a hyphen (or a path after a slash) and then between characters.

title: Stability: no label is clipped, in light and dark, focused or not, at several zooms
when: In light and dark, on the Exploring domain and its Define stage at depths 1 to 3 and zoomed in twice.
then: Expects every drawn box in the canvas to fit each of its lines (each line the map broke its kind and ID line and its title into), read from the drawn scene: each line's width as the canvas measures it at its drawn font at most its placed width, and the line inside its box, with half a map unit and half a pixel to spare.

title: Stability: a label keeps its size in the map when the focus changes and the camera zooms
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, reads its Design stage's title font size in the drawn scene (its font on screen over the zoom) and its lines, focuses the stage and then zooms in.
then: Expects the font size in map units and the lines unchanged each time, and the title's size on screen to change only with the camera's zoom.

title: In the Nested map siblings share one text scale and one header band, and every label fits its box
when: In every test map.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one text scale, above 0 and at most their side over 400, equal to the least of their labels' largest fits (a leaf's in its square, a parent's in a header band a quarter of it), a word too wide for a busy part's leaves lowering their scale and their cousins' in the same part but not their parent's, and the parents among them one header band, the tallest of their labels; every label wrapped within its box's width, no word broken, its lines giving back its title, a leaf's inside its square and a parent's inside its header band; and the same map object for an index whatever the focus.

title: Every title in Lathe's spec and the Tool Library wraps on whole words, none broken inside a word
when: Reads every record of Lathe's own spec and the Tool Library's, wraps each title as its box would (in its kind's shape's room).
then: Expects the lines to give the title back, every line but the last to end after a space or after a hyphen inside one word too wide for a line, and a component's file path to break only after a slash or a hyphen.

title: In the Voronoi map siblings share one text scale, at most their size's, and each label wraps on whole words inside its outline
then: Expects every group of sibling cells in the test maps to share one text scale, above 0 and at most the smallest sibling's square root of its area over 400; every cell's label box inside its outline, a parent's above where its children start; every title line but the last ending after a space and no line wider than the label; one map per index whatever the focus, the same map for a spec loaded again with the same tree, and the worker's layout of the tree read from the index equal to the one made here.

title: A framed box's header reads at the same size on screen at every depth, and the camera can frame the deepest leaf
when: Loads the repo's own specs (Lathe and the Tool Library) and, in each layout, frames every box at depth 1 in a 770 by 640 pane with the real camera.
then: Expects every frame within the camera's zoom limits; the framed title's median size on screen at each depth exactly the same at every depth in Nested and in the Tree (of each parent but the product whose text its column sets and whose frame its columns' width sets), within 40% across depths in Voronoi, and between 9 and 20 pixels; and the smallest box of each map framed short of the zoom limit.

title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box, and drawn at that size times the zoom
when: For every box of the Tree, Nested and Voronoi maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's at text scale 1 times the box's text scale, and the whole line inside its box (a cell's inside its polygon), and every badge inside its box. On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a line under `TEXT_BAR_PX` drawn as a bar. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.

title: The Nested map holds each box's children below its header band, top-down from the product's fixed square, siblings equal squares
when: Lays out the test workspaces, synthetic trees and a product with a busy part and a quiet one.
then: Expects every child inside its parent's padding below the header band, siblings never overlapping, a parent before its children in the keyboard's order, and the same roots and children as the Tree map; every root the product's square, every group of siblings equal squares, and the busy part and the quiet one the same size with the busy one's children smaller.

title: Children are a grid of equal squares in the tree's order, with the column count that makes them largest
then: Expects four squares in a square room to be two by two, five in a wide room one row, three in a square room two columns with a blank cell and the gap taken off the side, no column count giving larger squares than the one chosen, and in every test map each parent's children in the tree's order, row by row, a gap apart.

title: In the Nested map siblings share one text scale and one header band, and every label fits its box
when: In every test map.
then: Expects every group of siblings to share one text scale, above 0 and at most their side over 400, equal to the least of their labels' largest fits (a leaf's in its square, a parent's in a header band a quarter of it), a word too wide for a busy part's leaves lowering their scale and their cousins' in the same part but not their parent's, and the parents among them one header band, the tallest of their labels; every label wrapped within its box's width, no word broken, its lines giving back its title, a leaf's inside its square and a parent's inside its header band; and the same map object for an index whatever the focus.

title: The Voronoi map holds each cell's children inside its outline, equal-area cells top-down from the product's fixed hexagon, the same every time
when: Lays out the test workspaces and synthetic trees.
then: Expects every cell convex with its node's box as its bounding box, every child's corners inside its parent's outline and below its header's cut, siblings never overlapping, a parent before its children in the keyboard's order, and the same roots and children as the Tree map; the product a flat-topped hexagon of the fixed area, as wide as the product box; at least 95% of cells within 5% of their siblings' mean area, whatever the records under them; the same tree giving an equal map, a record added under one parent leaving every cell outside it, and that parent's own, exactly in place, and one shape split the same way at any place and size; and the convex helpers insetting, cutting and crossing a square.

title: In the Voronoi map siblings share one text scale, at most their size's, and each label wraps on whole words inside its outline
then: Expects every group of sibling cells in the test maps to share one text scale, above 0 and at most the smallest sibling's square root of its area over 400; every cell's label box inside its outline, a parent's above where its children start; every title line but the last ending after a space and no line wider than the label; one map per index whatever the focus, the same map for a spec loaded again with the same tree, and the worker's layout of the tree read from the index equal to the one made here.

title: Depth counts levels of the tree below the focus, stages and folders included, with the parent kept
when: Frames a requirement at depths 1 to 3 (the same picture: it has nothing below it), the Define stage at each depth (its folders, their records, their children), and an aggregate.
then: Expects the parent kept, each node's distance and the node it was reached from, only parent lines, and no sibling or link.

title: The glide follows the shared easing: CSS's ease, read from the motion tokens
then: Checks the easing curve against CSS's ease walked finely, a pan halfway through the time most of the way there, and the motion tokens parsed as the stylesheet writes them.

title: The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth shows below it, the parent at the left edge
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2, a stage at depth 3, a use case and a short group in a wide level, on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus within the padding top to bottom and centered on its middle, the framed levels fitting the canvas, the parent in view in a strip at the left edge with the focus right of it, deeper frames never zooming in further, every frame within the camera's zoom limit and a leaf framed short of it, and the whole map fitting the overview.

title: Focusing a child glides the camera on the shared motion, and no box moves or changes size
when: Opens a use case's graph, framed at once, clicks its requirement.
then: Expects the camera to glide there over several frames and end framing it, every box drawn before and after at the same place and size, and Back gliding back.

title: Under reduced motion focusing frames the new focus at once
when: Asks for reduced motion, clicks a requirement in its use case's graph.
then: Expects one camera move, straight to the framed view.

title: Depth counts levels below a domain and a use case, as a file explorer does
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 to 3.
then: Expects its stages, then their folders, then what is in them, one level more each time; and a use case in a capability, its capability the only node above it at every depth.

title: The ERD frames its boxes in focus only, and its context boxes are out of focus
then: Expects the framed boxes to leave out the ring, and on the page the ring box faded and aria-hidden, its line faded, and the key explaining it.

title: The glide is one smooth zoom and pan, from the view as it is to the framed one
then: Expects the zoom path between a domain's frame and a requirement's to start and end at those views, its zoom changing smoothly between frames, and its duration the shared speed for a short path and at most twice it for a long one.

title: Every drawn box shows its label, however small on screen, and is a keyboard stop; the summary counts the framed picture
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 3 with sixty requirements a few pixels tall.
then: Expects every drawn box to show its kind and ID line and its title, and every box in the keyboard layer to be drawn, with an accessible name, a Tab stop and not hidden from assistive technology; the keyboard order over every drawn box, column by column; and the summary counting the framed picture.

title: Stability: focusing anything moves the camera only, and no box changes its place or size
when: Focuses a domain, a stage, a folder, a capability and a use case by clicking, then goes Back twice and Forward once.
then: Expects each step stable, the camera different at each, and every box seen to keep the same place and size in the map throughout.

title: In the Nested view the camera frames the focus box, whatever the depth, and draws each box with its label
when: Frames a domain, a stage and a record in the Nested map on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus's box centered and within the padding, every drawn box only its ID (its label always drawn), a parent drawn before its children, nothing drawn out of view or under 3 pixels, and the drawing within its budget.

title: In the Voronoi view the camera frames the focus cell, and the page draws each cell as its outline
when: Frames the product, a domain and a use case in the Voronoi map on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus's box centered, every drawn cell in view and at least 3 pixels across, a parent drawn before its children, the drawing within its budget and the focus drawn. On the page, with the Voronoi layout chosen, expects each cell drawn as its polygon with its label inside, the pointer finding the cell at its label's middle and not at a corner of its bounding box outside its outline, and a click on a child gliding the camera to frame its cell.

title: A framed box's header reads at the same size on screen at every depth, and the camera can frame the deepest leaf
when: Loads the repo's own specs (Lathe and the Tool Library) and, in each layout, frames every box at depth 1 in a 770 by 640 pane with the real camera.
then: Expects every frame within the camera's zoom limits; the framed title's median size on screen at each depth exactly the same at every depth in Nested and in the Tree (of each parent but the product whose text its column sets and whose frame its columns' width sets), within 40% across depths in Voronoi, and between 9 and 20 pixels; and the smallest box of each map framed short of the zoom limit.

title: The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth shows below it, the parent at the left edge
when: Frames a domain at depths 1 and 2, a stage at depth 3, a use case and a short group in a wide level, on a canvas of 1000 by 800.
then: Expects the focus within the padding top to bottom and centered on its middle, the framed levels fitting the canvas, the parent in view in a strip at the left edge with the focus right of it, deeper frames never zooming in further, every frame within the camera's zoom limit and a leaf framed short of it, and the whole map fitting the overview.

title: Only boxes in view and big enough are drawn, each with its label, with bars for the rest, within a budget
when: Frames a domain.
then: Expects only boxes in view and at least 3 pixels tall, each drawn as its ID alone (its label always drawn); far out, no box too small and a bar for each run of tiny children inside its parent's span; a forced box drawn whatever its size; the same view drawing the same; and a synthetic product of more than 3,000 nodes within the budget at every zoom.

title: Every drawn box shows its label, however small on screen, and is a keyboard stop; the summary counts the framed picture
when: Opens a domain's graph at depth 3 with sixty requirements a few pixels tall.
then: Expects every drawn box to show its kind and ID line and its title, and every box in the keyboard layer to be drawn, with an accessible name, a Tab stop and not hidden from assistive technology; the keyboard order over every drawn box, column by column; and the summary counting the framed picture.

title: A label keeps its size in the map: its text scale is the map's, and the camera never changes it
then: Checks every box's text scale is at most its column's width over 400, set by the map, and that at a quarter, one and four times a domain's framing zoom every drawn box carries no text size of its own: the camera never changes a label.

title: Stability: at depth 2 on a domain, the domain, its stages and their folders are framed in the canvas, each showing its full title wrapped on whole words
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph at depth 2.
then: Expects, in the drawn scene, the domain, every stage and at least half the folders wholly in the canvas, and every framed box (the domain, its product at the left edge, its stages and their folders) labeled with its whole title, each of its lines fitting as drawn and every line but the last ending after a space or a hyphen.

title: Stability: a label keeps its size in the map when the focus changes and the camera zooms
when: Opens the Exploring domain's graph, reads its Design stage's title font size in the drawn scene (its font on screen over the zoom) and its lines, focuses the stage and then zooms in.
then: Expects the font size in map units and the lines unchanged each time, and the title's size on screen to change only with the camera's zoom.

title: Each label line is placed in map units at its face's size times its box's text scale, inside its box, and drawn at that size times the zoom
when: For every box of the Tree, Nested and Voronoi maps of the test workspace.
then: Expects each label line's size to be its face's at text scale 1 times the box's text scale, and the whole line inside its box (a cell's inside its polygon), and every badge inside its box. On the page, expects each drawn line's font on screen to be its map size times the zoom, and a line under `TEXT_BAR_PX` drawn as a bar. Expects the canvas's measure to read each width once at its face's font, and the plain measure to be the same every time.

title: Only boxes on screen are drawn, placed relative to the camera's center
then: Expects a box on screen drawn and a box wholly past an edge culled, a far box coming into view when the camera zooms out about the same center, and a tiny box deep in a very large map, at a very deep zoom, placed as exactly as one near the origin.

title: A domain's ERD draws one dashed reacts-to line per aggregate pair and event, from the aggregate raising it to the one reacting, with the event's name as its label on hover
when: Builds a domain's ERD.
then: Expects exactly one dashed line per aggregate's `reacts_to` link to another aggregate's event, both ways across a domain boundary, none for an aggregate's own event, the other domain's lines as context, and reacts-to lines fanned wider apart. Renders it and expects each line's hover label to be its event's name over a wider stroke, shown on the shared hover speed (none under reduced motion) and always by touch.

title: An ERD draws exactly one line per relationship link
when: Builds every aggregate's ERD in a domain.
then: Expects their lines together to be exactly the domain's entity relationship links, each once, and the domain's ERD to draw one line per aggregate pair and direction, standing for every refers_to link that crosses aggregates.

title: Opens a form of typed inputs, writes only what changed, and shows the record changed
when: Opens a requirement's page, chooses Edit, changes its statement and group, and saves.
then: Expects a form of typed inputs in place of the page's content, one write with only the changed columns, and the page showing the record changed.

title: Gives every column but the ID and the parent columns a typed input, in the table's order
when: Builds the form fields of several kinds from a schema description.
then: Expects one input per column in the table's order, typed by the column: a select for an enum, a number for a whole number, a check for true or false, a date, a list, with required columns marked.

title: Offers as parents and link targets only records of the allowed kinds in the same product
when: Asks for a record's parent choices and the targets of the links its kind may start.
then: Expects only records of the allowed kinds, in the record's product, never the record's own subtree as a parent.

title: Keys are shown as the platform shows them
when: Formats bindings for a Mac and elsewhere, then on a Mac.
then: Expects ⌘B, ⌥⌘B and ⌥1 in tooltips, ⌘P in quick find and ⌘\ in the palette.

title: Every control with a shortcut has aria-keyshortcuts
then: Expects `aria-keyshortcuts` on the nav toggle, quick find, the spaces, Checks, the view toggles (Alt+W and Alt+G first, off a Mac) and the side bar toggles, the depth buttons and full screen (Ctrl+3), and none for a sequence.

title: A color below WCAG AA while editing gets a warning beside its swatch
when: Sets the light muted text to a pale gray.
then: Expects warnings with the ratio on paper and on sheet in the light cell only, and a value that is not a color to be refused.

title: Each folder window reopens where it was left, and always on a screen
when: Saves windows for several folders, then places them against one or two screens.
then: Back where they were, centered when off every screen, shrunk to the largest screen, and never below the minimum size.

title: A second launch or a folder from Finder goes to the running app, which opens or focuses its window
when: Reads the folder from unpacked and packed command lines, routes a second launch to open its folder (relative to where it was launched) or to bring the app forward, routes a folder from Finder now or once ready, and finds an open folder's window however its path is spelled.

title: Whole-ID matching
Allowed test levels
